title: Mediterranean Seafood Toast
description: A twist on the classic toast, this Mediterranean seafood toast combines the savory flavors of the sea with the tanginess of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes or until lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the seafood mix and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the seafood is opaque and cooked through.
Stir in the feta cheese, parsley, lemon juice, and garlic.
Remove the toasted bread from the oven and top each slice with the seafood mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
